crossRefs.note: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to…
Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:
Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
“For this is like the waters of Noah to me; for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah will no more go over the earth…
For I will not contend forever, neither will I always be angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls…
Yahweh, correct me, but gently; not in your anger, lest you reduce me to nothing.
Don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant,” says Yahweh; “for I am with you; for I will make a full end of all the nations…
For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.
But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

translations.web: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
translations.bsb: O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
translations.kjv: O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
translations.asv: O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thine anger, Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
